insights.title: DMart West Zone OSA Outperformance
insights.text: DMart West Zone demonstrates 92.4% On-Shelf Availability with 1.12x promoter index, highest among all zones. Opportunity to replicate planogram discipline in other zones.

insights.title: Reliance South Zone SKU Availability Gap
insights.text: Reliance South Zone flagged with critical SKU availability gap below 85% threshold. Immediate field intervention required for hero-EAN OSA audit.

insights.title: National Compliance Declining Month-over-Month
insights.text: Overall compliance percentage shows 2.1% MoM decline. Central Zone contributing 65% of the compliance erosion. Root cause: promotional shelf space encroachment.
